points: The Q3 print will reveal whether revenue landed inside the $2.465B-$2.490B guided range, which already implies only 0%-1% constant-currency growth; a result near the low end would confirm stalled demand and put the full-year $9.925B-$10.025B target at risk.

Q2 non-GAAP operating margin fell 70 bps year over year to 11.9% and GAAP operating margin fell 220 bps to 3.9%; the Q3 report will show whether this margin compression continued, which would undercut the FY2 consensus EPS growth of 6.2% on essentially flat revenue.

Q2 highlighted iX Suite deals up 400% year over year, and reports suggest AI bookings are surging while offshoring pressures sales; the print will show whether those deals are converting into revenue and margin in Q3, or whether the core business is still eroding.

With full-year revenue guidance implying just 0.25%-1.25% constant-currency growth, the Q3 result and any guidance revision will set up Q4 to carry the load; a Q3 miss or unchanged weak guidance would require an unlikely Q4 acceleration to avoid a full-year cut.

The 90-day revenue estimate is down 6.47% and analysts have cut estimates 3 times with zero raises in the past 30 days; the print will either validate that downward drift or force more cuts to the FY1 $11.20 and FY2 $11.89 consensus.

Q2 generated $242M in adjusted free cash flow against a full-year target of $630M-$650M; the print will reveal whether the back half can deliver the bulk of that guidance, and a shortfall would add execution risk to the short case.
watch: Q3 reported revenue at or below the $2.465B low end of guidance — supports the short.
Q3 constant-currency revenue growth at or below 0.0% — supports the short.
Non-GAAP operating margin below Q2's 11.9% / further year-over-year compression — supports the short.
Full-year 2026 revenue or adjusted free cash flow guidance lowered from $9.925B-$10.025B or $630M-$650M — supports the short.
